A standalone radio streaming watch App that plays through the watch speaker.

Leave your phone at home and browse over 26,000 radio stations from around the world to stream directly on your Apple Watch.

* Search for Radio Stations directly on your Apple Watch

MusicView is a simple client for Spotify and AppleMusic.
You can view top charts in any country and quickly play any of the tracks.

You can create your own custom widget themes so they match any setup.

Pixel Music is a music sequencer based on images. Take an image you love and start playing.

Overview
◦ Pixels turn into pitch, velocity, and note durations  
◦ Play multiple images at the same time, in sync
◦ Choose what parts of the image will be played and at what timing
◦ Tap on the image and record yourself playing alongside the sequencer

Features
◦ AUv3 with preset and MIDI support
◦ Ableton Link compatible
◦ Control sequencer timing and configuration
◦ Choose between RGB, Luminance, Hue, or Saturation data to control pitch, velocity, or note duration
◦ Choose how the image is traversed, between Left -> Right, Top -> Down, or Circular. Select randomness factor in image traversal
◦ Choose recorded loop length and quantization settings
◦ Internal Synth with delay and reverb effects
◦ Send MIDI to external synths when used as AUv3. Each image you add has a separate MIDI channel exposed in the AU host
◦ Save and Load app states and configurations
◦ Dark mode support
